examples.text: Tom no llevaba su chaleco salvavidas.
examples.en: Tom wasn't wearing his life jacket.

examples.text: ¿Por qué lleva Tom un chaleco amarillo?
examples.en: Why is Tom wearing a yellow jacket?

examples.text: Tom llevaba un chaleco antibalas, así que la bala no le mató.
examples.en: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
